title: The Age of Revolutions
dek: Of how the cost of winning wars broke three empires, and how revolution passed from Boston to Paris to Saint-Domingue to Caracas.

panels.label: Revolutionaries Tell It
panels.text: Free peoples rose against tyranny in the name of the rights of man, and each revolution inspired the next.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Each revolution began in a fiscal or dynastic crisis of the empire above it. Ideas spread fast, but war debt and empty thrones opened the door.

panels.label: The Tour
panels.text: 10 stops on the Chronosphere globe, from Paris to Ayacucho.
